meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目从起步到现在的开发历程整理成一篇叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想回顾项目从零到现在的完整开发历程并写成一份报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a project's development history into a narrative report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to retell a project's full development journey as a report

howto.what: 读取 claude-mem 中某个项目的完整开发时间线,交给子代理写成一篇《Journey Into [项目]》叙述式报告,涵盖架构演变、调试经过与 token 统计,并保存为 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求「时间线报告」「项目历史分析」「开发历程」等时触发;需要 claude-mem worker 正在运行,且该项目已有记录。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份 journey 报告
say.note: 取全量时间线并生成报告

say.text: 分析 my-app 的整个开发历史

howto.what_en: Fetches a project's full claude-mem timeline, has a subagent write a narrative "Journey Into [Project]" report covering history, architecture and token economics, then saves it as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey or full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker running and recorded observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a journey report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline, then generates the report
